This notebook implements the corresponding author's decision that Figure 1
describes the microbial and phage communities before the transcriptomic story.
It combines the sampling design, aligned stacked compositions, Bray-Curtis
ordinations, and the design-aware community tests. Taxonomic trees and detailed
differential-abundance landscapes remain supplementary.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/build_community_figure_one.qmd [output-directory]
```

```{r}
#| label: build-community-figure-one
#| echo: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

write_checksums <- function(output_dir) {
  files <- list.files(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  files <- files[file.info(files)$isdir %in% FALSE & basename(files) != "output_checksums.md5.tsv"]
  fwrite(data.table(
    path = sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(output_dir), "/"), "", normalizePath(files)),
    bytes = file.info(files)$size,
    md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files))
  ), file.path(output_dir, "output_checksums.md5.tsv"), sep = "\t")
}

root <- normalizePath(getwd())
if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))) abort("Run from the repository root")
source(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))

project_data <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
output_dir <- if (length(args)) normalizePath(args[[1L]], mustWork = FALSE) else
  file.path(project_data, "derived", "community_figure_one")
if (dir.exists(output_dir)) abort("Output directory already exists: %s", output_dir)
staging <- file.path(dirname(output_dir), sprintf(".community-figure-one-staging-%d", Sys.getpid()))
dir.create(file.path(staging, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(staging, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
on.exit(if (dir.exists(staging)) unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)

paths <- list(
  metadata = file.path(root, "metadata", "sample_metadata.tsv"),
  mag_profile = file.path(project_data, "derived", "taxonomic_resolution_exploration", "tables", "family_top25_community_profile.tsv"),
  mag_colours = file.path(project_data, "derived", "taxonomic_resolution_exploration", "tables", "family_microshades_colour_key.tsv"),
  votu_profile = file.path(project_data, "derived", "taxonomic_timeseries_layout_comparison", "tables", "votu_realm_profile.tsv"),
  votu_colours = file.path(project_data, "derived", "taxonomic_timeseries_layout_comparison", "tables", "votu_realm_colour_key.tsv"),
  pcoa = file.path(project_data, "derived", "community_differential_abundance", "tables", "community_pcoa.tsv"),
  permanova = file.path(project_data, "derived", "community_differential_abundance", "tables", "community_restricted_permanova.tsv"),
  da_summary = file.path(project_data, "derived", "community_differential_abundance", "tables", "analysis_summary.tsv"),
  mag_clr = file.path(project_data, "derived", "community_differential_abundance", "tables", "mag_matched_clr.tsv"),
  votu_clr = file.path(project_data, "derived", "community_differential_abundance", "tables", "votu_matched_clr.tsv")
)
missing <- names(paths)[!file.exists(unlist(paths))]
if (length(missing)) abort("Missing inputs: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

metadata <- fread(paths$metadata)[, .(sample_title, condition, phase, cycle)]
sample_levels <- c("C1-I", "C1-B", "C2-I", "C2-B", "C3-I", "C3-B")
metadata[, `:=`(
  sample_label = factor(sprintf("C%d-%s", cycle, fifelse(phase == "initial", "I", "B")), levels = sample_levels),
  condition_label = factor(fifelse(condition == "control", "Control", "Phage-UV"), levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV")),
  phase_label = factor(fifelse(phase == "initial", "Initial", "Backflush"), levels = c("Initial", "Backflush"))
)]
setorder(metadata, condition_label, sample_label)

condition_palette <- c("Control" = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]], "Phage-UV" = phage_uv_condition_colours[["phage_uv"]])

design <- ggplot(metadata, aes(as.integer(sample_label), condition_label, colour = condition_label, shape = phase_label)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(1, 2), colour = "#ECECEC", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(group = condition_label), colour = "#BDBDBD", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2, stroke = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = condition_palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Initial" = 16, "Backflush" = 17), name = "Sample fraction") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(sample_levels), labels = sample_levels, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.03))) +
  labs(x = "Three cleaning cycles sampled before and after backflush", y = NULL, tag = "A") +
  theme_phage_uv(9) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

mag <- fread(paths$mag_profile)
mag_colours <- fread(paths$mag_colours)
mag <- merge(mag, metadata[, .(sample_title, sample_label, condition_label)], by = "sample_title", all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c(".old", ""))
mag[, display_category := factor(display_category, levels = rev(mag_colours$display_category))]
mag_palette <- setNames(mag_colours$colour, mag_colours$display_category)
mag_legend <- mag_colours[category_type == "top25 named" | display_category == "Other phyla"]
mag_legend[, legend_label := fifelse(display_category == "Other phyla", "Other phyla", paste(phylum, display_category, sep = " | "))]
mag_labels <- setNames(mag_legend$legend_label, mag_legend$display_category)

mag_stack <- ggplot(mag, aes(sample_label, relative_abundance, fill = display_category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.82, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.08) +
  facet_grid(condition_label ~ ., scales = "fixed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mag_palette, breaks = mag_legend$display_category,
                    labels = mag_labels[mag_legend$display_category], name = "Phylum | family", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance among MAG-mapped reads", tag = "B") +
  theme_phage_uv(8.2) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.8),
        legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.27, "cm"), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7), plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE))

votu <- fread(paths$votu_profile)
votu_colours <- fread(paths$votu_colours)
votu <- merge(votu, metadata[, .(sample_title, sample_label, condition_label)], by = "sample_title", all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c(".old", ""))
realm_order <- votu[, .(mean_abundance = mean(relative_abundance)), by = realm][order(-mean_abundance)]$realm
votu[, realm := factor(realm, levels = rev(realm_order))]
realm_palette <- setNames(votu_colours$colour, votu_colours$realm)

votu_stack <- ggplot(votu, aes(sample_label, relative_abundance, fill = realm)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.82, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.08) +
  facet_grid(condition_label ~ ., scales = "fixed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = realm_palette, breaks = realm_order, name = "Viral realm", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = "Cycle and fraction", y = "Relative abundance among high-quality vOTU reads", tag = "D") +
  theme_phage_uv(8.2) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7), plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

pcoa <- fread(paths$pcoa)
pcoa <- merge(pcoa[, !c("condition", "phase", "cycle"), with = FALSE], metadata, by = "sample_title", all.x = TRUE)
pcoa[, condition_label := factor(condition_label, levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV"))]
permanova <- fread(paths$permanova)
da_summary <- fread(paths$da_summary)[model == "phase_cycle_adjusted"]
matched_summary <- data.table(
  community = c("MAG", "vOTU"),
  matched_tested = c(nrow(fread(paths$mag_clr)), nrow(fread(paths$votu_clr))),
  matched_fdr05 = c(
    sum(fread(paths$mag_clr)$exact_signflip_fdr < 0.05),
    sum(fread(paths$votu_clr)$exact_signflip_fdr < 0.05)
  )
)

make_ordination <- function(community, tag) {
  target_community <- community
  x <- pcoa[community == target_community]
  stats <- permanova[community == target_community]
  da <- da_summary[community == target_community]
  matched <- matched_summary[community == target_community]
  annotation <- sprintf("Paired Bray-Curtis exact p = %.4g\nAdjusted DA: %d/%d at FDR < 0.05\nMatched CLR: %d/%d at FDR < 0.05",
                        stats$exact_p, da$fdr05, da$features_tested,
                        matched$matched_fdr05, matched$matched_tested)
  ggplot(x, aes(axis1, axis2, colour = condition_label, shape = phase_label)) +
    geom_path(aes(group = interaction(condition_label, phase_label)), colour = "#C8C8C8", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8) + geom_text(aes(label = cycle), colour = "white", size = 2.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("label", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = annotation, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1,
             size = 2.25, linewidth = 0.15, fill = alpha("white", 0.88)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = condition_palette, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Initial" = 16, "Backflush" = 17), name = "Sample fraction") +
    labs(x = "Bray-Curtis PCoA axis 1", y = "Bray-Curtis PCoA axis 2", tag = tag) +
    theme_phage_uv(8.2) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}

mag_pcoa <- make_ordination("MAG", "C")
votu_pcoa <- make_ordination("vOTU", "E")

figure <- design /
  (mag_stack + mag_pcoa + plot_layout(widths = c(1.85, 1))) /
  (votu_stack + votu_pcoa + plot_layout(widths = c(1.85, 1))) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.58, 2.2, 1.45)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Microbial and phage community structure across three cleaning cycles",
    caption = paste(strwrap(paste(
      "Stacked bars retain the six discrete observations for each membrane. MAG and vOTU community tests use exhaustive paired label swaps across the six phase-cycle cells.",
      "Because one membrane represents each condition, the comparisons are exploratory and do not estimate a replicated treatment effect."
    ), width = 155), collapse = "\n")
  )

figure_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "community-structure-figure-one.pdf")
ggsave(figure_path, figure, width = 16.5, height = 12.5, device = grDevices::pdf)

registry <- data.table(
  panel = LETTERS[1:5],
  content = c("sampling design", "MAG family composition", "MAG Bray-Curtis PCoA", "vOTU realm composition", "vOTU Bray-Curtis PCoA"),
  source = c(paths$metadata, paths$mag_profile, paths$pcoa, paths$votu_profile, paths$pcoa),
  status = "allocated_main_figure_1"
)
fwrite(registry, file.path(staging, "tables", "figure_one_panel_registry.tsv"), sep = "\t")
figure_stats <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "community"),
  list(
    permanova,
    da_summary[, .(community, features_tested, fdr05, fdr05_abs_lfc1)],
    matched_summary
  )
)
fwrite(figure_stats,
       file.path(staging, "tables", "figure_one_statistics.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(data.table(input = names(paths), path = unlist(paths), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(unlist(paths)))),
       file.path(staging, "tables", "input_provenance.tsv"), sep = "\t")
write_checksums(staging)
if (!file.rename(staging, output_dir)) abort("Failed to promote Figure 1 output")
cat(sprintf("Community Figure 1 written to %s\n", output_dir))
```
